verdict.rationale: cubic's privacy and security docs state that its AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit not to train or improve their models on code snippets and metadata sent through their APIs. Organizations can also ask cubic to completely block AI features for their workspace, so code is protected from third-party training by default. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on whether cubic trains its own models on customer code, a self-serve opt-out control for the workspace-specific memory/learning from feedback and historical reviews, and independent corroboration of the no-training commitment.
